desc: Compact and easy to transport, the Daniel Defense DDM4 PDW Pistol is the kind of firearm you can rely on for home and personal defense plus its a ton of fun to shoot. This highly maneuverable modern sporting rifle comes with a MFR XL flat front rail for fast handling, accuracy, and reliability while also providing compatibility with a wide variety of accessories. The DDM4 PDW features M-LOK attachment points and an SLR M-LOK MOD2 Plain Front Handstop to help ensure a safe shooting experience.
